HEADER: Init: +1; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, eye of the storm, Perception +14
DEFENSE: AC 15, touch 10; flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +1 dex, +2 natural, - 1 size)
Defensive Abilities Natural Armor; Resist Earth 5, Fire 4, Ice 4, Lightning 4, Water 4, Wind 4;
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Geomancy (11/day, +5 attack bonus, 3d6+4, DC 17)
Special Abilities Geomancy Tricks (Improved Geomancy, Infiltration[7 hours], Track), Homefield Advantage (1/day, 7 rounds), Terrain Movement (7/day)
At-will (DC 14) - Create Water, Detect Magic, Elemental Orb, Ignite, Read Magic, Virtue
1st (DC 15) - Burning Disarm (DC 16), Frostbite, Stone Fist, Wind Armor, Wind Shield
2nd (DC 16) - Barkskin, Burning Arc (DC 17), Flaming Sphere (DC 17), Frost Fall
3rd (DC 17) - Call Lightning, Ice Spears, Meld into Stone, Wind Wall
STATISTICS: Str 16, Dex 13, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 19, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +9; CMD 20 (24 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Casting, Elemental Focus (fire), Extend Spell, Extra MP

SQ Armored Mage (light), Clear Mind, Endure Elements, Favored Terrain (Plains and Mountain, +2), Fast, Geosynchronous, Ley Lines +2 (Plains), Natural Mount, Nature Sense, Spell Proficiency, Undersized weapons
Gear cure potion (3), 4th-lvl geomancer scroll, scythe, shortspear (5), hide shirt
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Centaurs gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed.
Centaurs have tough skin, granting them a +2 natural armor bonus.

A centaur counts as having the Mounted Combat feat only for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisites, and substitutes the Acrobatic skill for any Ride skill prerequisites when acquiring feats that have Mounted Combat as a prerequisite. Because of his equine form, a centaur can wield a lance one-handed as if mounted and deals double damage with a lance while charging. A centaur can never gain the benefit of the Mounted Combat feat (or other similar feats or effects, such as Trick Riding) if ridden by another creature.

Although a centaur is Large, its upper torso is the same size as that of a Medium humanoid. As a result, they wield weapons as if they were one size category smaller than their actual size (Medium for most centaurs).

curation.summary: Centaur Geomancer is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 63 generated item(s) across 9 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
